description: This file defines a PHPUnit test class 'SearchWrapperTest' that contains unit tests for the 'SearchWrapper' class in the SuiteCRM Search module. The tests cover fetching search engines, handling custom engines, performing searches, and retrieving configurations related to the search functionality.
published: SuiteCRM	ests in	ests unctions	estSearchWrapper
SuiteCRM	ests in	ests unctions	estSearchWrapperErrorHandling

classes.name: SearchWrapperTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the SearchWrapper class's functionality in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: testFetchEngine
methods.description: Tests that the fetchEngine method correctly retrieves an instance of 'ElasticSearchEngine' using reflection.

methods.name: testFetchEngineNonExisting
methods.description: Verifies that fetchEngine throws SearchEngineNotFoundException when a non-existent engine is requested.

methods.name: testFetchEngineCustom
methods.description: Tests that fetchEngine correctly loads a custom engine 'MockSearch'.

methods.name: testFetchEngineCustomBad
methods.description: Ensures fetchEngine throws SearchEngineNotFoundException for a bad mock engine.

methods.name: testGetEngines
methods.description: Verifies that the list of available engines matches expected engine names.

methods.name: testSearchAndDisplayCustom
methods.description: Tests the search and display functionality with a custom engine 'MockSearch'.

methods.name: testSearchAndDisplayBuiltIn
methods.description: Tests the search and display process using a built-in engine 'SearchEngineMock'.

methods.name: testFakeSearch
methods.description: Tests the search method with mock engines, verifying specific search hits.

methods.name: testSearchCustomEngine
methods.description: Checks that a mock SearchEngine instance can perform a search without errors.

methods.name: testGetModules
methods.description: Verifies that getModules returns an array with more than one module.

methods.name: testGetDefaultEngine
methods.description: Ensures getDefaultEngine retrieves the correct default engine from configuration.

methods.name: testGetController
methods.description: Ensures getController retrieves the controller setting from configuration.
